description: Search US court opinions (Caselaw Access Project, public domain) by case name / keyword, court, jurisdiction, and decision-date range. Returns matching case metadata with CAP ids and citations. Use caselaw_opinion_text with a returned id to read the full opinion. Note: v1 index covers the U.S. Reports reporter (official US Supreme Court reporter).

query.description: Case name or keyword, e.g. 'Brown Board Education', 'Miranda'.

name: caselaw_search
